name: Mahira Homes 104
usps: Strategically located on the 150/24 meter Dwarka Expressway, ensuring seamless connectivity to major hubs.
Unparalleled dedicated car parking space for every single home (1,500 car parks for 1,483 apartments), an exceptional feature for affordable housing.
Subsidized benefits are available under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojna (PMAY) for eligible beneficiaries.
Energy-efficient and seepage-resistant apartments constructed with earthquake-resistant RCC frameworks.
amenities: Open gym, jogging track, basketball court, and dedicated skipping area.
Yoga centre, senior citizen sitting area, gazebo, and kids play area.
Integrated community centre, restaurant, and boutique shops.
24x7 CCTV surveillance, comprehensive firefighting system, and rainwater harvesting infrastructure.
target_audience: Budget-conscious buyers, PMAY beneficiaries, and nuclear families seeking an affordable, amenity-rich lifestyle with dedicated parking and direct access to the Dwarka Expressway.
